review.visual: Hero, exploded, macro and side-by-side stills and five loop frames inspected: no fireflies, shadow acne or clipping; metal reflections plausible.
review.limits: No motion blur. Per-frame denoise; consecutive-frame difference in largely static regions measured at about 1/255 mean per channel. Four of five studio lights are hidden from the camera but appear in reflections. Glass blocks shadow rays. Schematic teaching model, not validated mechanics.
review.sideBySide: Left panel quotes Examples/PathTrace/Sources/MartyPathTrace/Gearbox.swift lines 12-15 verbatim; the program refuses to render if they differ from the built values.
